title: Israel Strikes Hamas Military Wing Chief Mohammed Odeh on Eid Eve — Killed Alongside Family in Gaza City
detail: On the eve of Eid al-Adha (May 26, 2026 / Day 958), Israel struck a residential building in the Rimal neighborhood of Gaza City, targeting Mohammed Odeh — the newly appointed commander of Hamas's Izz al-Din al-Qassam Brigades, who had assumed the role just 11 days after his predecessor Izz al-Din al-Haddad was killed on May 16. The strike killed Odeh, his wife, his son, and his daughter — a total of 5 dead including 4 members of the Odeh family. At least 12 people were injured. Israeli Defense Minister Israel Katz publicly announced the targeting, calling Odeh 'one of the architects of the October 7 massacre' and noting this was the fourth time Israel had killed the head of Hamas's military wing since that day. Prime Minister Netanyahu also confirmed the strike. The operation was conducted by the IDF and Shin Bet in coordination. Odeh had previously served as a senior Hamas intelligence officer. His killing came as Gazans were marking the start of Eid, one of Islam's most important holidays.

media.caption: Israel kills Hamas Qassam Brigades chief Mohammed Odeh in Gaza City on eve of Eid al-Adha — May 26, 2026

title: IDF Strikes Tel al-Sultan Displacement Camp in Rafah — At Least 45 Killed Including in Crowded Civilian Area
detail: Israeli forces bombed the Tel al-Sultan area of Rafah on May 26, 2026 (Day 958 / Eid al-Adha eve), killing at least 45 people in and around a displacement camp where hundreds of thousands of civilians are sheltering. Israel stated that the strike targeted two senior Hamas officials embedded within the camp and that IDF forces had documented killing approximately 200 militants in the Rafah area and discovered dozens of weapons caches. The strike on Tel al-Sultan provoked a dangerous incident at the Gaza-Egypt border: an Egyptian soldier was killed in a skirmish that broke out in connection with the Israeli military action in the corridor near the border fence — marking one of the most serious Israel-Egypt military incidents in decades. The Tel al-Sultan displacement camp has been a site of recurring deadly strikes throughout the renewed campaign. Gaza's health authorities described the scene as catastrophic, with bodies brought to overwhelmed hospital facilities nearby.

media.caption: At least 45 killed as IDF strikes Tel al-Sultan displacement camp in Rafah on Eid al-Adha eve — May 26, 2026

title: Egyptian Soldier Killed at Gaza-Egypt Border in Skirmish Linked to IDF Rafah Operations
detail: An Egyptian soldier was killed on May 26, 2026 in a border incident at the Gaza-Egypt frontier that broke out in connection with Israeli military operations in the Rafah area. The incident marked one of the most serious Israel-Egypt military confrontations in decades, raising acute concerns about potential spillover of the Gaza conflict. Egypt summoned the Israeli ambassador and issued a strong protest. Egyptian state media confirmed the soldier's death, which occurred in the area near the Tel al-Sultan operations. Cairo has maintained tense but stable relations with Israel during the war but has repeatedly warned against any further escalation near the border. The Egyptian military placed forces on heightened alert in Sinai near the Gaza border following the incident.

media.caption: Egyptian soldier killed at Gaza-Egypt border during Israeli operations in Rafah — May 26, 2026
